note: Pierce County NE has no queryable zoning service found. County zoning (Zoning Resolution 2000, official zoning map provision) is published as PDF text and map. City of Pierce publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (zoning_map.pdf) with no GIS viewer or layer. Plainview's zoning ordinance and district boundary map are PDF documents. The county GIS viewer (pierce.gworks.com) exposes no zoning layer and its parcel-based sites are paid or third-party. No ArcGIS Online zoning layer for Pierce County NE or its cities was found; only paid parcel vendors list zoning codes.
